facts.fact: The Communications Authority of Kenya and the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics report from the 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey that 35.0% of individuals nationally use the internet (37.8% of males, 32.2% of females); no age range is given for the national figure, and the age breakdown starts at 3-4 years. The survey year is 2023/24, recorded as 2024.
facts.system: Kenya Housing Survey 2023/24 internet usage by individuals

systems.system: Kenya Housing Survey 2023/24 internet usage among youths (18-34 years)
